A robot program failed to move "yellow_block" (kind: block) onto "purple_box".

```python
candidates = grasp_candidates("yellow_block")
candidate = candidates[0]  # Use first candidate
grasp(candidate)
spots = free_spots("purple_box")
spot = spots["spots"][0]
carry_to(spot["x"], spot["y"], height=0.18, yaw=spot["gripper_yaw"])
lower_until_contact()
open_gripper()
retreat()
check("yellow_block", "purple_box")
```

Object as seen by the camera: {"height": 0.0399, "top_z": 0.8399, "footprint_long": 0.0399, "footprint_short": 0.0392, "long_axis_yaw": 0.245, "short_axis_yaw": -1.326}
